大家看到眼前的一幕，惊呆了，脸上满是不可思议之色。

用拳头硬接昊天锤，还赢了！

未免太夸张了吧。

昊天锤是斗罗大陆第一器武魂，拥有极致力量和极致爆发属性，就算是没有附加任何魂环重量也有五百斤。

唐三的修为虽然只有二十九级，但依靠昊天锤的基础属性，全力砸下来，也能爆发出极强的力量。

没有魂圣的修为，根本就不敢徒手硬接。

就算是赵无极这种拥有大力金刚熊这种防御力极强的魂圣，在没有防备之下，也被唐三的昊天锤砸得鼻青脸肿。

可是，叶寒仅仅只用了拳头，便将昊天锤和唐三轰飞。

如此体魄，简直骇人惊闻。

“卧槽，这小子，肉身什么时候变得这么强了，都快赶上我了！”

赵无极最先回神过来，难以置信的诺诺自语着。

叶寒刚才展现出来的体魄，已经完全刷新了他的认知。

“好小子，果然有点能耐。”

“难怪能硬抗唐昊的威压，能在我的七杀剑域下感悟领域。”

“这体魄，这悟性，简直无敌了。”

“风致，我看叶寒的资质足以称之为斗罗大陆第一人。”

剑斗罗似乎看穿了叶寒的情况。

就在刚才，他能从叶寒的体内感知到一股强大的血脉之力。

这股力量很强，好像跟龙族有关。

若不是剑斗罗并没有发现叶寒的身上散发出任何魂兽的气息，以及见识过叶寒的嗜血魔剑武魂，他刚才就已经把叶寒当成化形为人的魂兽了。

因为人类的体魄是不可能变得这么强的，除非是体内拥有强大的魂兽血脉，或者是拥有更加诡异的武魂，例如自己的身体、手臂、大脑等等。

他曾经看过一种记载，武魂可以来自动物、植物、天气、元素和能量等，同样的，武魂也有可能来自自身。

而这种来自自身的武魂，被一些人称之为本体武魂。

只是世上对本体武魂的记载太少了，这种魂师也太少了。

就目前为止，本体武魂只存在于记载中，现实中还没有出现任何本体武魂魂师。

或许，叶寒也是一位双生武魂魂师，第一武魂是嗜血魔剑，第二武魂是本体武魂。

以叶寒刚才那一拳的表现，他的第二武魂应该是右臂，或者是整个身体。

看来叶寒身上的秘密还有很多。

“不，不可能！”

“你怎么可能硬接我的昊天锤！”

唐三稳住身形，脸上满是不可思议。

昊天锤是他的武魂，力量有多强，他比谁都清楚，同样也是他现在最强的底牌。

可谁能想到，他赖以信任的强大底牌，在叶寒的面前却分文不值，一点威力也没有。

明明是斗罗大陆第一器武魂，但就是被人用拳头打回去了，任谁遇到了，都很难接受。

“因为我比你强！”

叶寒可不想解释，随便回了一句，双腿一蹬，便以极快的速度冲了过去。

唐三感知到叶寒的强势，哪儿还敢去找原因，当即施展鬼影迷踪闪避。

但叶寒对鬼影迷踪太熟悉了，瞬间找到了破绽，让唐三的闪避全部失效，只能用身体和脸蛋来承受他的拳头。

一拳，两拳，三拳......

叶寒不知打了多少拳，唐三被揍得鼻青脸肿，口吐鲜血。

那残忍的样子，看得大家都不忍直视。

本来戴沐白想要帮忙的，直接被吓得呆愣在原地，迟迟不敢动手。

此时此刻，他才意识到叶寒的实力到底有多强。

跟几天前相比，已经发生了翻天覆地的变化。

而在大家的震惊中，也只有小舞才明白这是怎么回事。

能让叶寒发生如此巨大变化的，只有他体内那股强大的魂兽血脉。

Everyone was shocked when they saw the scene in front of them, with incredible expressions on their faces.

He caught the Clear Sky Hammer with his fist and still won!

That's too much of an exaggeration.

The Haotian Hammer is the first martial spirit in Douluo Continent. It possesses ultimate strength and extreme explosive properties. It weighs five hundred kilograms even without any attached soul rings.

Although Tang San's cultivation level was only level twenty-nine, relying on the basic attributes of the Clear Sky Hammer, hitting it with all its strength could still unleash an extremely powerful force.

Without the cultivation of a Soul Saint, one would not dare to take it hard with bare hands.

Even a Soul Sage like Zhao Wuji, who had a powerful defense like the Mighty Diamond Bear, was bruised and bruised by Tang San's Clear Sky Hammer without any precautions.

However, Ye Han only used his fist to blast away the Clear Sky Hammer and Tang San.

Such a physique is simply shocking.

"Damn it, this kid, when did his body become so strong? He's almost catching up with me!"

Zhao Wuji was the first to come to his senses, and Nuonuo muttered to himself in disbelief.

The physique Ye Han showed just now has completely refreshed his understanding.

"What a good boy, you are indeed quite capable."

"No wonder you can resist Tang Hao's pressure and understand the realm under my Seven Kills Sword Domain."

"This physique and understanding are simply invincible."

"Fengzhi, I think Ye Han's qualifications are enough to be called the number one person in Douluo Continent."

Sword Douluo seemed to see through Ye Han's situation.

Just now, he could sense a powerful bloodline power from Ye Han's body.

This power is very strong and seems to be related to the dragon clan.

If Sword Douluo hadn't noticed any soul beast aura emanating from Ye Han's body, and had seen Ye Han's bloodthirsty demon sword spirit, he would have mistaken Ye Han for a soul beast that had transformed into a human.

Because it is impossible for a human body to become so strong unless he has a powerful soul beast bloodline in his body, or he has a weirder martial soul, such as his own body, arms, brain, etc.

He once read a record that martial souls can come from animals, plants, weather, elements, energy, etc. Similarly, martial souls can also come from oneself.

And this kind of martial spirit that comes from one's own body is called the original martial spirit by some people.

It's just that there are too few records of the original martial soul in the world, and there are too few such soul masters.

So far, the original martial soul only exists in records, and no original martial soul soul master has appeared in reality.

Perhaps, Ye Han is also a soul master with twin martial souls. The first martial soul is the bloodthirsty demon sword, and the second martial soul is the original martial soul.

Based on the performance of Ye Han's punch just now, his second martial spirit should be his right arm, or his entire body.

It seems that Ye Han still has many secrets.

"No, it's impossible!"

"How could you forcefully take my Clear Sky Hammer!"

Tang San stabilized his figure, his face full of disbelief.

The Clear Sky Hammer is his martial spirit. He knows better than anyone how powerful it is. It is also his strongest trump card now.

But who would have thought that the powerful trump card he relied on would be worthless and had no power at all in front of Ye Han.

It was obviously the first martial soul in Douluo Continent, but it was beaten back with fists. It would be difficult for anyone who encountered it to accept it.

"Because I'm better than you!"

Ye Han didn't want to explain, so he replied casually, kicked his legs, and rushed over at an extremely fast speed.

Tang San sensed Ye Han's strength and dared to find the reason, so he immediately used Ghost Shadow to dodge.

But Ye Han was too familiar with ghost shadows and found a flaw in an instant, making Tang San's dodges useless and he could only use his body and face to withstand his fists.

One punch, two punches, three punches...

Ye Han punched him countless times, and Tang San was beaten until his nose was bruised and his face was swollen, and he vomited blood.

The cruel look was so cruel that no one could bear to look at it.

Dai Mubai originally wanted to help, but he was so frightened that he froze in place and did not dare to take action.

At this moment, he realized how strong Ye Han was.

Compared with a few days ago, a huge change has taken place.

Among everyone's shock, only Xiao Wu understood what was going on.

The only thing that could make Ye Han undergo such a huge change was the powerful soul beast bloodline in his body.
